Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
On VTES-L, Xian writes:
> LSJ, could you re-post that bit about the Mob Connections, re: my rambling
> on about how it seemed like most master cards were default controlling
> methuselah's minions only, and pretty much everyone told me that I wasn't
> thinking clearly?

It's on Dejanews: http://www.dejanews.com/getdoc.xp?AN=400284933

The highlights (with citations added): Master cards that affect
minions can affect any controlled minion by default [RTR], with
the exception that only Methuselahs who control one of the
combatants can affect the combat. [RTR 09-FEB-95]

Addendum:
The Feb'95 ruling was later overturned to "Presses can only be
provided by players involved in the combat, so you cannot use Mob
Connections or Police Department on a combat you're not involved in.
Elysium and Frenzy may be used regardless of whether you're involved
in the combat." [RTR 09-MAY-95]

The bit about Elysium was reversed again when VTES came out (late '95).

> As I recall, of the combat locations from Jyhad, only
> Elysium: the Arboretum was restricted to your own minions... what was the
> deal with Mob Connections, Police HG...were they changed from Jyhad to
> V:TES, and back again, and what is the current state of these cards... on
> the rulemonger site, there wasn't any errata or rulings on these latter
> cards...

None of the locations, Elysium included, were restricted to your own
minions by the Jyhad card texts. They were all affected, briefly, by
the Feb'95 ruling, which was discarded in May'95 only to return in
the actual card text when VTES was released in Nov'95.

Since the actual card texts takes care of everything, no ruling or
errata is necessary, so the Rulemonger site includes none. (That is,
in the absense of errata, the actual latest card text stands.)
